name: maine-probate-forms
description: Route a plain-language fact pattern to the correct Maine probate court form and produce a filled PDF via a deterministic, VLM-free fill path.

interface.shortDescription: Route + fill Maine probate court forms
interface.longDescription: Go from a plain-language situation to the right Maine probate form and a filled PDF. A single-call router selects the form from a compact catalog; the fill path (plan + inject) is deterministic and needs no VLM at fill time. Bundles an MCP server (find_forms / get_form / fill_form) and a routing-and-fill skill. Not legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Help me fill out the right Maine probate court form for my situation
